name: Gatekeeper
tagline: Shows you what you would have to drop before you say yes to something new
description: Before a new commitment goes on the pile, it makes the trade explicit: what gets delayed, what gets dropped, and what you are quietly deciding not to do.

source.excerpt: Shared as a bot that forces the trade-off before you take on anything else.

body:
## What it does

Before a new commitment goes on the pile, it makes the trade explicit: what gets delayed, what gets dropped, and what you are quietly deciding not to do. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @liam_fallen shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
